controls.label: Ring bloom
controls.description: How far the occasional ring bloom spreads (0 off, 1 fills the screen).

controls.label: Ring echoes
controls.description: Out-of-phase echo copies per spectrum ring (0-2).

controls.label: Segments
controls.description: Number of mirrored wedges around the centre.

controls.label: Cycle length
controls.description: Seconds for one full off-and-on cycle.

controls.label: On fraction
controls.description: Share of each cycle in which the kaleidoscope is on, including its fades.

controls.label: Transition
controls.description: Seconds to ease in and again to ease out. Limited to half the on time.

controls.label: Spin
controls.description: Rotation speed of the wedge pattern in radians per second.

controls.label: Amount
controls.description: Maximum blend toward the kaleidoscope. Zero keeps the original image.

controls.label: Force
controls.description: Added to the cycle blend, so an audio or LFO binding can push the effect in at any time.
